label: UPF (Quantum ESPRESSO v2)
engines: ld1 oncvpsp uspp opium atompaw ape
note: The default. Read by Quantum ESPRESSO and, increasingly, by other codes.

label: UPF v1 (legacy text)
note: Older text layout. Only for tools that cannot read UPF v2.  # convert-only; not built into the store

label: psp8 (ABINIT)
note: ABINIT's native norm-conserving format.

label: PSML
note: Portable XML interchange format used by SIESTA and ABINIT.  # ONCVPSP rejects psfile=psml; see check_data.f90:57

label: FHI / abinit
note: The fhi98PP layout, read by ABINIT and older codes.

label: CASTEP recpot
note: CASTEP's reciprocal-space format.

label: SIESTA psf
note: SIESTA's own format.

label: CPMD
note: CPMD's numeric pseudopotential format.

label: CASINO
note: Quantum Monte Carlo, CASINO code.

label: CHAMP
note: Quantum Monte Carlo, CHAMP code.

label: Teter
note: Teter's format, an older ABINIT input.

label: QSO / Qbox XML
note: Qbox and the quantum-simulation.org schema.

label: NCPP
note: Plain norm-conserving tabulation.

label: UPF XML schema
note: Converted from UPF with QE's upfconv.x -x.

label: cpi (FHI/abinit)
note: What fhi98PP itself writes; see docs/ENGINES.md on converting it.

label: Vanderbilt .uspp
note: The uspp code's own binary format, before conversion.

label: Vanderbilt .van (ASCII)
note: The ASCII form QE's upfconv.x can read.

label: GTH coefficients (CP2K)
note: The CP2K potential block: an analytic coefficient table, not a radial grid. Read directly by CP2K.

label: GTH coefficients (CPMD)
note: The same coefficients in the CPMD &ATOM layout.

label: GTH coefficients (ABINIT)
note: The same coefficients as an ABINIT psp3/HGH input.

label: PAW dataset (ABINIT)
note: ABINIT PAW dataset, written from the same solve as the UPF.

label: PAW-XML schema
note: The PAW-XML schema read by GPAW and ABINIT.

label: OpenMX .vps
note: ADPACK's native norm-conserving format, read by OpenMX. Not UPF; see docs/ENGINES.md.

label: OpenMX pseudo-atomic orbitals
note: The basis that accompanies a .vps set.
